name: Hanasaka Airi
source:
"Looking from a distance is good enough... because idols are stars."

A young woman with a blooming love for idols. 
Kind x Straightforward x Idol Otaku

An ordinary college student at a private university in Tokyo. She's rather quiet and reserved. If someone mentions something she likes, she'll perk up and geek out. Because she used to attend an all girls' high school, she hasn't had many opportunities to interact with guys. Before she noticed, though, she got into male idols. Her current favorite group is HEARTiS.

Hobby: cooking
Likes: idols
Hates: exercising

[Translated from [url=http://www.entremets-cd.com/products/stalove]official website[/url]]
